description: This file defines the PHP class 'ObservabilityAdminClient' which extends the AWS SDK's AwsClient. It provides methods to interact with the CloudWatch Observability Admin Service, including starting, stopping, and listing telemetry evaluations for resources and organizations.

classes.name: ObservabilityAdminClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with the CloudWatch Observability Admin Service, extending the AWS SDK's AwsClient.

methods.name: getTelemetryEvaluationStatusAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the telemetry evaluation status.

methods.name: getTelemetryEvaluationStatusForOrganization
methods.description: Retrieves telemetry evaluation status for an organization.

methods.name: getTelemetryEvaluationStatusForOrganizationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves telemetry evaluation status for an organization.

methods.name: listResourceTelemetryForOrganization
methods.description: Lists resource telemetry data for an organization.

methods.name: listResourceTelemetryForOrganizationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists resource telemetry data for an organization.

methods.name: startTelemetryEvaluationForOrganization
methods.description: Starts telemetry evaluation for an organization.

methods.name: startTelemetryEvaluationForOrganizationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts telemetry evaluation for an organization.

methods.name: stopTelemetryEvaluationForOrganization
methods.description: Stops telemetry evaluation for an organization.

methods.name: stopTelemetryEvaluationForOrganizationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously stops telemetry evaluation for an organization.
